decision: Nova recommends actions but cannot automatically change CRM opportunity stages.
rationale: Sales accountability remains with the account team and irreversible automation would weaken trust.

decision: Every recommendation must cite CRM, meeting, or account-plan evidence.
rationale: Sellers need to validate why a recommendation exists and distinguish evidence from model inference.

decision: Pilot is limited to strategic account directors.
rationale: The cohort has richer account context and can provide disciplined qualitative evaluation.

decision: Expansion requires human-reviewed quality and hallucination thresholds.
rationale: Business value depends on recommendation reliability, not just engagement or click-through.

decision: Nova may only surface evidence already visible to the requesting account team.
rationale: AI must not become a side channel that bypasses CRM or account-document permissions.
